title: Structured projector blocks and bulk assembly for conditional kappa = 1.2523415e-5
body:
This extends [PR #24](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/24) at `ed90fd940279c336ebc45968631bdebfb087b505` with one new commit, retaining the #10 → #18 → #24 ancestry. It also adopts the attributed PR #21, PR #23 and RaD interfaces described below.

Under the retained multiplication framework and those analytic/tape interfaces,

$$
T(n)=O\!\left(n(\log n)^{1-\kappa}\right),\qquad
\kappa=\frac{2504683}{200000000000}=1.2523415\times10^{-5}.
$$

## Construction

The bit network uses `(32,30,36)`. New A1 and A5 decompositions preserve contiguous blocks. The middle axis uses the fixed rational basis `I+J`; bounded-minor CRT certificates establish its complete internal pivot profile, including the required zeros. The selected profile has rank mass `2843940`.

The complex network uses `(30,30,40)` with mixed dyadic centers, disjoint-center counts 19 and 35, translated endpoints, and complete physical-data batching. Its scalar and frame checks support one coherent producer and carrier assignment.

The strict component savings are `1252373/100000000000` (bit) and `131/5000000` (complex). Their certified moment gaps exceed `2.8159e-14` and `1.0940e-9`, respectively.

The assembly adapts **Zhihao Chen (jacklightChen)**'s PR #23 composition of **RaD (hipotures)**'s completed-child semantic precision, arbitrary-coordinate routing, phase-cell Gaussian inverse and bulk resampling. Translated complex endpoints follow Zhihao Chen's PR #21. The actual scalar gate charge gives `C1=1`; nested adapters pay the product of both row stocks, bounded by `p^108000`. All 47 strict constraints and seven assembly margins hold, with final absorption gap greater than `9.4453e-13`.

## Contribution sources and prior PRs

My preceding contributions under **icekylinx** form the direct implementation lineage:

| PR | Contribution | Conditional exponent saving |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [#10](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/10) | Contiguous projector batching, simultaneous controlled bases, mixed-width recursion and whole complex residuals; corrected Gaussian input enclosure while retaining `P=34p`. | `1.2299998e-7` |
| [#18](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/18) | Partial-swap frames and removal of the source rank penalty; binary retained totals, compatible carrier reuse and positive frames; selected `(25,23,57)` basis. | `1.884586e-6` |
| [#24](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/24) | Complementary auxiliary endpoint gauges, selected `(32,30,40)` basis, general nondegenerate binary phase residuals and updated precision guard. | `5.98615e-6` |
| This PR | A1/A5 block refinements, fixed `I+J` middle-axis profiles certified by bounded-minor CRT, mixed low-loss complex centers, complete data-front batching and instantiation of the attributed semantic/bulk assembly. | `1.2523415e-5` |

The adopted contributions are distinct from these new finite refinements:

| Source | Contributor | Role in this construction |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Original multiplication manuscript and repository framework | OpenAI; Douglas Colkitt; underlying analytic work of David Harvey and Joris van der Hoeven | Multiplication reduction, analytic recovery and the fixed-tape framework. |
| [#2](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2), [#4](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4) | Bortlesboat; dleen | Alignment, retained totals and stage sharing. |
| [#3](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3), [#5](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5), [#6](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6), [#13](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/13) | eumemic | Complex producers, Gaussian resampling, aligned circuits/centers and nonzero auxiliary source-frame context. |
| [#7](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7), [#16](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/16) | Zhihao Chen (jacklightChen) | Retained finite producers and nested-basis context. |
| [#21](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/21) | Zhihao Chen (jacklightChen) | Translated complex endpoints, used here with the new mixed-center network. |
| [#20](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/20), [pinned RaD sources](https://github.com/hipotures/rad/tree/45d9b60355872041f9275f77c057514def0d45bc/research/integer-multiplication-bounds) | RaD project (hipotures) | Completed-child semantic precision, arbitrary-coordinate routing, phase-cell Gaussian inverse and bulk locality/tape transfer. |
| [#23](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/23) | Zhihao Chen (jacklightChen) | Compatibility with the retained framework, literal scalar charge, product row reserves and strict semantic/bulk parameterization, adapted here to the selected networks. |

Related contributions by Rohan Arun and Aurel Prosz remain acknowledged in the retained notices. Baker–Harman–Pintz supplies the prime-interval theorem used by the adopted packing argument. Historical AI-assistance disclosures are preserved. The table records construction dependencies and contribution scope; independently published exponent savings are not added together.

## Proof and attribution

- `notes/structured-bulk-note.tex`: selected construction and assembly, supplied as LaTeX source.
- `scripts/structured_bulk_producer.py`: new producer and exact CRT reconstruction.
- `certificates/structured-bulk-network.json`: recursive moments, semantic precision, row accounting and assembly.
- `references/semantic-bulk/`: necessary pinned proof sources, original notices and licenses.

The result remains conditional on the retained analytic/tape interfaces, constructive setup and eventual thresholds. Finite checks do not formally verify the complete theorem. The inherited `patches/batched-23.patch` remains the #10 baseline; this extension is presented in its standalone proof.

The new selected finite constructions and integration are contributed by **icekylinx**, with substantial OpenAI GPT-6 Astra and Codex assistance. Original attribution is retained, including PR #23 at `661ebabc1076c9f525d7ce4967c876b203fa9827` and RaD at `45d9b60355872041f9275f77c057514def0d45bc`. The repository retains Apache-2.0; imported RaD sources retain CC0. Exploratory variants, duplicate snapshots and large raw graph dumps are excluded.

## Validation

- Regenerated the new h36 original-envelope producer and the h30 DAG used by the fixed-basis profiler.
- Recomputed all 184380 rank-greater-than-two transition profiles. All 1020 three-prime cases agreed; deterministic primality and bounded-minor inequalities passed. The complete block counts match the selected certificate.
- Rebuilt both mixed-center complex producers and matched every carrier count and histogram entry; exact scalar and frame checks passed.
- Reconstructed both child lists and certified their moments, semantic induction, product row reserves, 47 strict constraints and seven assembly margins.
- Checked the final source diff for whitespace errors. Proof sources are included; no PDF compilation was performed this round.

Unchanged previous-round producer and regression checks were not rerun.
